svg.title: Where TrnRT stands
svg.desc: Total tokens per dollar on InferenceX AgentX, one TrnRT engine (8 Trainium2 chips) against one 8-GPU node, at AWS Capacity Block prices: 1.63 to 1.89 times H200's at 1 to 8 users and 1.09 times at 16 (0.87 times at 24 and 0.81 times at 32), and 3.9 to 5.2 times H100's at 16 to 32 users
